title: IELTS Listening Part 1 Question Feasibility Verdict
description: Semantic half of the question-feasibility preflight. The deterministic half (blueprint version, validator errors, answer-variety counts) is supplied by validate_part1.py; this document carries only what a model can add. The two are combined by question_feasibility_preflight.py, which is the authoritative consumer of this shape. Not a material audit: no verdict, no score.

feasible.description: Whether ten reliable, uniquely-answerable, gap-fillable Part 1 items can be written from the ten planned points. A false here costs a full material regeneration, so it must be accompanied by specific reasons.

reasons.description: One entry per problem, each naming the item number and the concrete cause. Required non-empty whenever either boolean is false; may be empty when both are true.

category_semantics_ok.description: Whether every item's answer_category is semantically true of its answer. The validator already checked the values are among the 13 permitted strings; only a reader of both script and plan can check they are correct.

requested.description: Mandatory whenever this object is present: it is the whole meaning of the object. An exception object without it reads as a request while the consumer reads it as no request.

justification.description: What about the scenario makes the answer-variety concentration unavoidable. Required when requested is true; a requested exception with no justification is how a limit gets bypassed silently.

qr027_exception.description: Optional as a whole -- omit the key entirely when not requesting an exception. Written, it must be written correctly. justification is conditionally required rather than unconditionally: {"requested": false} is legal, because declining to request an exception leaves nothing to justify.
